top_creatures.label: Wraith pack
top_creatures.why: Alpha-blended translucency reads as ghostly at range and needs no new mesh.
top_creatures.keep: Translucent body and slow drift idle.
top_creatures.change: Our own silhouette, rim glow and stinger; no living-NPC mesh reuse.

top_creatures.label: Fallen watcher
top_creatures.why: A body that reads dead while its wings still move reads as a threat not yet spent.
top_creatures.keep: Death-pose idle and two-sided alpha-cut wings.
top_creatures.change: Wings open on aggro; our own wing shape; no FinalBlend.

top_creatures.label: Gilded beast
top_creatures.why: A sheen on an ordinary animal reads as rare at 375 px.
top_creatures.keep: The sheen as a rarity signal.
top_creatures.change: Rim light and spark motes instead of an environment map.

top_creatures.label: Small pest pack
top_creatures.why: Weak evidence: named in docs only; listed so a human can look.

top_creatures.label: Standard monster clip set
top_creatures.why: One readable seven-clip set across many creatures keeps fights legible.
top_creatures.change: Add a telegraphed special windup with a sound cue.

looks.label: Sprite emitter sheet
looks.technique: Camera-facing quads with colour ramp, opacity fade in and out, size-over-life curve, burst or stream spawn (714 emitters per header claim)

looks.label: Mesh emitter caster ring
looks.technique: Mesh emitter places a magic circle under each caster and a mesh bolt on the projectile

looks.label: Cloud alpha mask
looks.technique: Flat colour times an alpha mask; the alpha carries the shape, the RGB is constant

looks.label: Two-sided alpha-cut wings
looks.technique: FinalBlend with alpha test and two-sided flag on the wing texture

looks.label: Translucent ghost shader
looks.technique: Shader blend state chosen per NPC on living meshes

looks.label: Grade letter symbol
looks.technique: Letter symbol after a white item name; no colour tint on the name

looks.label: Armour mesh substitution
looks.technique: Per-slot mesh swap on the body, not an attached prop
